GOOD TO KNOW

A little clarity
goes a long way.

Sample cart choices may be saved on this browser. No personal data is requested.

Is this a live store?

No. Products, prices, accounts, editor tools and analytics are demonstrations. No purchase, payment, delivery or real authentication service is connected.

What is saved in my browser?

Only sample product IDs and cart quantities use this site's dedicated local-storage key. Demo roles, categories and simulated order history are memory-only. End the demo to clear its cart. Browser storage may be unavailable, in which case the cart stays in this tab only.

Are customer and editor views secure accounts?

No. Selecting a local demo role only changes the interface. It is not authentication, authorization, a protected server route, or row-level security. No real user records or administrative services exist here.

What does a sample order do?

It creates a local, explicitly labeled simulation and clears the sample cart. Nothing is sent, paid, reserved or shipped. Shipping and final payable total are unquoted.

Where do the analytics come from?

Seven fixed, labeled sample days, not live sales or your local simulations. The chart, table and CSV export share the same sample values.
